description.content: A Mist Edge Cluster (MxCluster) is a group of Juniper Mist Edge devices that are configured to work together in order to provide high availability and load balancing for the tunneling of traffic from access points (APs). The cluster can consist of a single edge device or multiple edge devices.
List Mist Edge clusters in the organization, which group one or more Mist Edge devices for tunneling, RadSec, and related edge services.
